slides.title: Identity Crisis Control Tower
slides.notes: Pinned source; isolated tests and detailed limits in TESTS.md. No hosted demo or official score.

slides.title: 1 · Missing validator does not stop review-file publication
slides.fix: Require ok is True before a validated sign-off.
slides.notes: A synthetic sign-off passed to save with a nonexistent validator wrote readiness.signed.json. The returned message explicitly said the findings were not checked. This is a fail-open save policy, not a hidden claim that validation ran.

slides.title: 2 · Development bypass can allow Ready with pending required checks
slides.fix: Keep the bypass useful for development but force an incomplete/development status and prohibit approval while required checks remain pending.
slides.notes: allow_missing=True marks unknown checks nonmaterial. assess starts at Ready and excludes these pending checks from the deciding set. The bypass is explicitly documented and is not the default; the risk is presenting its output as normal readiness. Acceptance: A card with an unavailable required check stays Insufficient Evidence even under a development run, or produces a clearly separate non-approvable draft result.

slides.title: 3 · Robustness failures disappear into empty objects
slides.fix: Record not-run, error type and affected claim as explicit evidence states.
slides.notes: Injected a ValueError into the robustness calculation only. assess returned a document with no explicit occurrence of the failure or reason. This is controlled fault injection, not evidence that the ordinary calculation always crashes.

slides.title: 4 · Reported group size includes unmeasured values
slides.fix: Preserve reference-compatible eligible counts but add measured counts and missing counts for each group beside the estimates.
slides.notes: A1 computes means with missing values skipped but reports n_positive and n_negative using Series.size. The robustness code explicitly acknowledges this reference-compatible convention. The count can therefore exceed the actual denominator of the mean and bootstrap. Acceptance: Leave at least one measured value per group and blank several others; display eligible, measured and missing denominators separately.

slides.title: 5 · Bootstrap independence needs a stated unit
slides.fix: State the sampling unit and verify one independent patient per unit, or use patient-cluster resampling when the question requires it.
slides.notes: The percentile bootstrap redraws observations within each ER group. The method, seed and repetitions are documented, which is good. If distinct sample IDs represent repeated specimens from a patient, independent observation resampling can overstate precision. This is a conditional statistical limitation, not an observed failure on the event dataset. Acceptance: A statistician reviews the interval and a repeated-patient synthetic example; document the supported independence assumption.

slides.title: What is verified so far
slides.fix: Read TESTS.md for skips, positive controls and limits.
slides.notes: 81 passed, 18 skipped, 0 failed, 0 errors; independent safeguards are targeted probes, not a score.
